WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (up, weak): stored not waterfront. The main campground runs out a narrow peninsula, the ODNR map draws Burr Oak Lake on both sides, and the end-loop sites 16-23 are ~60-80 m from water on OSIP leaf-off (0.78 m/px) through a wooded bank. No open apron, canopy in summer: *view candidate at most.
SPLIT not proposed: Dock 2 and Dock 3 are separate places but primitive 16-ft sites, so nothing for a 23-ft rig; equestrian camp is ~1 km up the same road.
